title: 第774章 就应该使用瘟疫和毒气才对第774章 地下城攻势的克制办法
slug: 领主反派破灭后开始当战犯
content_zh:
冒险者讨伐地下城魔物，勇者小队挑战魔王城堡——这种深入人心的叙事背后，隐藏着冷兵器时代面对复杂地形（如地下城、山脉、密林）时，大规模军队的无力。派大军清剿？代价高昂，效率低下，容易中埋伏，后勤压力巨大。而雇佣或培养一支由少数精锐（勇者小队）组成的特种部队，直捣黄龙，成本相对可控，政治风险小，成功后收益（财富、名声、甚至联姻）足以让参与者满意。对于统治者而言，用几个人的荣华富贵换取一个地区的安宁，甚至可能得到一个强力女婿（如果勇者是男性且未婚），是一笔非常划算的买卖。
“可惜，‘召唤勇者’这套把戏，在我这里行不通。”林恩冷笑。他绝不可能将希望寄托在来历不明、不可控的“天降系”身上。更何况，根据古籍记载，大规模、稳定的异界勇者召唤，早就是“天灾时代”之前的老黄历了，如今的世界法则似乎已经发生了变化。
那么，面对依托复杂地形（山地、丛林、以及现在遇到的地道网络）进行顽强抵抗的敌人，历史上的常规手段有哪些？
围剿，或称“堡垒推进战术”。建立密密麻麻的碉堡、哨所、封锁线，步步为营，压缩敌人的活动空间，最终将其困死或逼出来决战。
这套战术的核心思想是“优势在我”，依靠绝对的后勤、资源和兵力优势，稳扎稳打。在“正规军打土匪”的剧本里，只要后勤跟得上，这几乎是必胜之法，虽然笨重、缓慢、烧钱，但几乎不会出错。
“但问题在于，”林恩的手指在地图上划过，“我们现在面对的，不是土匪，而是另一支正规军（中土联军），以及拥有严密组织和特殊能力的异族军队（魔族）。用打土匪的战术去打正规军，尤其是在对方同样拥有一定后勤和动员能力的情况下，很容易陷入消耗战，甚至被对方利用内线优势反咬一口。”
历史上那位“光头”的失败，就是典型案例。他率领的看似是“正规军”，实则派系林立，夹杂大量战斗力低下、纪律涣散的“土匪式”部队，去围剿一支高度组织化、意志坚定、拥有群众基础的“正规军”，结果自然是被灵活机动的对手穿插分割，逐一击破。
第三种方法，则是来自另一段历史的智慧——那支以游击战起家、最终夺取天下的军队，在建国后面对西南匪患时，采取的策略：军事清剿、政治攻势、群众工作三结合。一方面调集优势兵力，采用“拉网合围”、“梳篦清剿”等战术，将土匪赶出巢穴，压缩到预设的决战区域；另一方面，发动群众，建立基层政权，切断土匪与当地百姓的联系（“取消他们的群众基础”），使其成为无源之水、无本之木。
“但是……”林恩的眉头深深皱起，“这里是异世界，情况更复杂。”
中土联军的普通士兵和百姓，或许可以争取、分化，通过宣传战、经济手段甚至武力威慑，让他们不再支持联军。但魔族呢？
根据情报，魔族社会结构复杂，许多种族仍保留着原始、野蛮的习性。对于其中相当一部分种族如某些食人魔、兽人而言，人类和其他智慧生物，就是‘食物’或‘消耗品’的一部分。
指望通过宣传让他们“弃暗投明”，或者指望当地人类百姓能对魔族产生“群众基础”，无异于天方夜谭。
这是死仇，不能教化。
黎明帝国千年前教训，已经够惨了，根据目前的推算，好像是有十多亿人口被吃了。
圣母就赶紧去死。
而黑翼族、部分高等魔族、利维坦、魅魔、九尾狐等种族，九尾狐，他们不吃人。
但魅魔也并非不吃，九尾狐也是，他们吃...色情一点的吃...反正不是人肉，但不代表不吃。
但那些以人类为食的种族，其存在本身，就与北方联盟宣扬的秩序、文明、以及最基本的生存权，构成了不可调和的矛盾。
“非我族类，其心必异？”非常正确！
那么，针对当前最棘手的地道战、山地游击战，结合这个世界的实际情况，林恩心中逐渐勾勒出一个冷酷而高效的组合策略：

1.
持续升级的“技术碾压”与“非对称打击”：
毒气战（化学魔法）：既然有效，就要更大规模、更精准地使用。研发针对不同种族生理特性的特种毒剂（如对哺乳类高效、对爬行类无效；或利用魔法特性，制造只破坏特定魔力回路的“魔力毒雾”）。
声呐生命探测魔法强化：不仅要探测生命，还要尝试区分生命形态、实力等级，实现更精准的定位打击。
工程魔法与爆破结合：不仅仅是从头顶垂直爆破。可以研发能够钻入地下一定深度再引爆的“钻地炸弹”，或者使用土系魔法制造局部塌方，活埋整段坑道。
环境改造：大规模使用冰系魔法冻结地下水脉，破坏敌方水源；使用植物系魔法催生特定根系破坏地道结构；甚至考虑使用禁忌的“地脉扰乱”魔法，引发局部地震。
2.
战略层面的“驱赶与围歼”：
坚壁清野与机动歼灭：在无法迅速攻克的山地、丛林区域，不再执着于一城一地的争夺。利用空中优势（飞艇、狮鹫侦察）和快速机动部队（摩托化、骑兵、魔法传送），建立立体监视网络。一旦发现敌军大股部队聚集或建立根据地，立即调集重炮、轰炸机、甚至战略魔法进行覆盖式打击，将其歼灭在集结地或行军途中。
制造“无人区”与“隔离带”：在关键战线后方，利用燃烧弹、持久性毒剂、或大规模改变地形（如制造沼泽、流沙），制造宽度可观的隔离区域，切断游击队与后方基地的联系。
重点拔除节点：集中精锐特种部队（由高阶超凡者组成），在情报支持下，对敌方的指挥中枢、补给节点、重要工坊、魔法阵核心进行“斩首”式打击。
3.
政治与心理层面的“分化与瓦解”：
区别对待，拉打结合：向所有魔族和中土联军控制区喊话，明确列出“不可饶恕”的种族和行为（如食人、大规模虐杀平民、使用禁忌魔法等），同时给出投降、合作的条件。对非食人种族、以及中土联军中动摇的贵族、将领，秘密进行策反、诱降。
content_en:
Adventurers crusade monsters in dungeons, and brave teams challenge the devil's castle. Behind this deeply rooted narrative lies the powerlessness of large-scale armies in the cold weapon era when facing complex terrains (such as dungeons, mountains, and dense forests). Send an army to wipe out? It is expensive, inefficient, easy to be ambushed, and has huge logistical pressure. To hire or train a special force composed of a small number of elites (brave team) to go straight to Huanglong, the cost is relatively controllable, the political risk is small, and the benefits (wealth, fame, and even marriage) after success are enough to satisfy the participants. For the ruler, exchanging the prosperity and wealth of several people for the tranquility of a region, and maybe even getting a powerful son-in-law (if the brave man is male and unmarried), is a very good deal.
"Unfortunately, the trick of 'summoning the brave' doesn't work here." Lin En sneered. There is no way he would place his hopes on the "Heavenly Fall System" with unknown origins and uncontrollable origin. What's more, according to ancient records, large-scale and stable summons of heroes from other worlds have long been in the old almanac before the "Era of Natural Disasters". Today's world laws seem to have changed.
So, what are the conventional means in history when faced with enemies that rely on complex terrain (mountains, jungles, and now the tunnel network) to resist tenaciously?
Encirclement and suppression, also known as "fortress advance tactics". Establish dense bunkers, outposts, and blockades, and work step by step to compress the enemy's activity space, and eventually trap them to death or force them out for a decisive battle.
The core idea of ​​this tactic is "the advantage lies with me", relying on absolute advantages in logistics, resources and troops to fight steadily. In the scenario of "regular troops fighting bandits", as long as the logistics can keep up, this is almost a sure-fire way to win. Although it is cumbersome, slow, and expensive, it is almost error-free.
"But the problem is," Lin En's finger traced across the map, "what we are facing now is not bandits, but another regular army (Chinese-Turkish Allied Forces), and a foreign army (Devils) with strict organization and special abilities. Using the tactics of fighting bandits to fight the regular army, especially when the opponent also has certain logistics and mobilization capabilities, it is easy to fall into a war of attrition, and even be bitten by the opponent using the inside advantage."
The failure of the "bald man" in history is a typical case. What he led seemed to be a "regular army", but in fact it was full of factions, mixed with a large number of "bandit-like" troops with low combat effectiveness and loose discipline. He went to encircle and suppress a "regular army" that was highly organized, determined and had a mass base. The result was naturally that it was interspersed and divided by flexible opponents and defeated one by one.
The third method is the wisdom from another period of history - the strategy adopted by the army that started out as guerrilla warfare and eventually conquered the world when it faced the banditry in the southwest after the founding of the People's Republic of China: a combination of military suppression, political offensive, and mass work. On the one hand, superior forces were mobilized and tactics such as "encirclement with nets" and "clearance and suppression" were used to drive the bandits out of their lairs and compressed into the preset decisive battle area; on the other hand, they mobilized the masses, established grassroots political power, and cut off the connection between the bandits and the local people ("eliminating their mass base"), turning them into water without a source and a tree without roots.
"But..." Linn frowned deeply, "This is a different world, and the situation is more complicated."
Ordinary soldiers and civilians of the China-Turkish coalition may be able to win over, divide them, and use propaganda wars, economic means, or even force to deter them from supporting the coalition. But what about the demons?
According to the intelligence, the social structure of the demon race is complex, and many races still retain primitive and barbaric habits. For quite a few of these races, such as some ogres and orcs, humans and other intelligent creatures are part of 'food' or 'consumables'.
It is tantamount to expecting them to "abandon the darkness and turn to the light" through propaganda, or to expect the local human people to develop a "mass base" against the demons.A fantasy.
This is a deadly feud and cannot be enlightened.
The lessons learned by the Empire of Dawn thousands of years ago were tragic enough. According to current estimates, it seems that more than one billion people were eaten.
The Holy Mother died immediately.
As for the Black Wings, some high-level demons, Leviathans, succubi, nine-tailed foxes and other races, the nine-tailed foxes do not eat humans.
But it's not that succubi don't eat, and so do nine-tailed foxes. They eat... something a little more erotic... It's not human flesh anyway, but that doesn't mean they don't eat it.
However, the very existence of those races that feed on humans constitutes an irreconcilable contradiction with the order, civilization, and the most basic right to survival preached by the Northern Alliance.
"If they are not from my race, their hearts must be different?" Very true!
So, for the current most difficult tunnel warfare and mountain guerrilla warfare, combined with the actual situation of the world, Lin En gradually outlined a cold and efficient combination strategy in his mind:
1.
Continuously upgraded “technical crushing” and “asymmetric strikes”:
Poison gas warfare (chemical magic): Since it is effective, it must be used on a larger scale and more accurately. Develop special poisons targeting the physiological characteristics of different races (e.g., efficient for mammals but ineffective for reptiles; or use magical characteristics to create "magic poison mist" that only destroys specific magic circuits).
Sonar life detection magic enhancement: not only detect life, but also try to distinguish life forms and strength levels to achieve more precise positioning and strikes.
Engineering wizardry meets blasting: not just blasting vertically from overhead. You can develop "earth-penetrating bombs" that can drill into the ground to a certain depth and then detonate, or you can use earth magic to create local landslides and bury the entire tunnel alive.
Environmental transformation: Use ice magic on a large scale to freeze underground veins and destroy enemy water sources; use plant magic to spawn specific root systems to destroy tunnel structures; and even consider using the taboo "Ley Vein Disturbance" magic to cause local earthquakes.
2.
“Driving out and encircling and annihilating” at the strategic level:
Strong wall clearing and mobile annihilation: In mountainous and jungle areas that cannot be conquered quickly, there is no longer an obsession with fighting for one city or one place. Use air superiority (airships, gryphon reconnaissance) and fast mobile troops (motorized, cavalry, magic teleportation) to establish a three-dimensional surveillance network. Once it is discovered that a large number of enemy troops have gathered or established a base, they will immediately mobilize heavy artillery, bombers, and even strategic magic to carry out a covering strike to annihilate them at the assembly area or on the march.
Create "no man's land" and "isolation zone": Behind the key fronts, use incendiary bombs, persistent poisons, or large-scale changes in terrain (such as creating swamps and quicksand) to create a considerable width of isolation area to cut off the connection between the guerrillas and the rear base.
Focus on removing nodes: concentrate elite special forces (composed of high-level extraordinary beings), and with the support of intelligence, carry out "decapitation" attacks on the enemy's command center, supply nodes, important workshops, and the core of the magic array.
3.
"Division and disintegration" at the political and psychological levels:
Differential treatment, combined with fighting: shout out to all areas controlled by the demons and the Chinese-European coalition forces, clearly list the "unforgivable" races and behaviors (such as cannibalism, mass murder of civilians, use of forbidden magic, etc.), and also provide conditions for surrender and cooperation. Secretly instigate rebellion and induce surrender against non-cannibal races, as well as vacillating nobles and generals in the Central-European Allied Forces.
